description.value: Meat & Bread is a well-established Vancouver sandwich chain with multiple locations, known for its house-roasted porchetta and craft sandwiches served on artisan bread. The Robson Street outpost sits in the heart of downtown Vancouver and offers breakfast sandwiches in the morning alongside a full lunch lineup. Cyclists passing through the city centre will find a compact, efficient spot for a hearty midday meal with online pickup ordering available.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces, covered) at 56m; stands (2 spaces) at 61m; stands (2 spaces) at 63m; stands (2 spaces) at 92m; stands (2 spaces) at 93m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms the Robson Street location at 625 Robson St with an active menu and online ordering, corroborating OSM address and URL. OSM tags diet:vegetarian=yes and diet:vegan=no are supported by website menu items (Two Egg Veg, Grilled Cheese). Takeout is confirmed via 'ORDER PICKUP' and 'Order Delivery' on the website; no evidence for bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill from either source.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM or on website.
Water is listed on the menu as a purchasable item ('water 3 still or sparkling'); water bottle refill availability is unconfirmed.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-known downtown Vancouver sandwich spot with confirmed takeout and vegetarian options; a practical and convenient stop for touring cyclists passing through the city core.
